set.body: Owner decision 2026-10-11 (DESIGN_SPEC §15): the executable golden fixture (fixtures/studio-golden, SCORES.json = real eyes4s output) is authoritative for science values. The mock (docs/studio/fixture/make_fixture.py -> fixture.json) now derives its record allocation from the golden CSVs, but its per-query M/B/D, participant means and grand means still differ from SCORES.json. Reconciling changes board-visible numbers (e.g. D +0.38, +0.30/+0.15, +0.16) and the studio tests that read MockStudy, so: regenerate the mock scores from SCORES.json, update the boards' numbers and PARITY_CHECKLIST texts, re-baseline the dependent suites. Kept separate from the design landing on purpose.
set.title: Reconcile the mock fixture's science scores to the golden SCORES.json
